title: Graphiti doc led improvements - Adopt first-class Graph Namespacing
description:
References
- Graph namespacing: https://help.getzep.com/graphiti/core-concepts/graph-namespacing
- Communities: https://help.getzep.com/graphiti/core-concepts/communities
- Searching: https://help.getzep.com/graphiti/working-with-data/searching

Problem:
- We partially emulate scoping using:
  - group_id on Entity nodes (Graphiti-native), and
  - projectId we set manually on nodes for multi-tenancy, and
  - Area nodes (Entity:Area) as logical groupings.
- These concepts overlap and are not exposed uniformly through the API. We should align with Graphiti’s namespacing model to enable clear, safe isolation across tenants/projects/environments.

What Graphiti provides
- A formal namespacing pattern via group_id and collection/model settings so multiple graphs can co-exist in the same database/cluster without leakage.

features.title: Configuration & bootstrapping
features.description:
Add settings to explicitly control Graphiti namespacing for this service:
  - GRAPHITI_GROUP_ID: default to provider’s get_default_group_id, but allow override per deployment.
  - GRAPHITI_COLLECTION and GRAPHITI_MODEL already exist in config; surface and document how they align to Graphiti namespacing and vector store segregation.
Expose group_id consistently in API/agent methods so callers can scope read/write operations.

features.title: Ingestion alignment
features.description:
Update CodeIngestionService.ingest_repository to accept group_id explicitly and:
  - pass it to all service.create_node calls (we already do this, keep it consistent), and
  - ensure link_entity_to_area and any post-write operations do not lose the group_id context.
Add end-to-end tests that ingest two projects with different group_ids and verify queries do not leak results.

features.title: Query alignment
features.description:
Extend routers and agent_tools to accept optional group_ids (list) consistently:
  - /areas (list/get/update/delete)
  - /blueprints
  - /code-projects queries (files, dependencies, classes, types, refs)
Ensure GraphService list/get methods always apply the graph namespacing filter when provided (we already have helpers _project_condition and group_ids in some methods; standardize usage and add group_id filtering for all relevant endpoints).

features.title: Documentation
features.description:
Document the recommended mapping for this project:
  - Tenant or deploy environment -> group_id
  - Project/Repository -> Area node (Entity:Area), optionally also a projectId property for human-readable filtering.
  - Avoid using projectId as a primary isolation boundary; prefer group_id for true namespacing.

features.title: Testing
features.description:
Go over all the existing tests and update them with the new grouping idea.

Create a standalone test that pushes the boundaries of this idea so that we know that it's working correctly to the max.
